overview: A mentor on ICR can take you on for regular free mentoring, hold one-off sessions with you, or run group sessions and programmes. All of it is followed from **My mentoring**.

rules: Your plan allows a number of open requests at a time; **Requests** shows how many you have used.
A request the mentor has not answered lapses after a while.
The app asks for your mobile number the first time, if your profile has none.

after: A session your mentor proposed waits for your answer under **Needs you**: accept the new time or keep the one already booked.

website: Paying for a mentor's paid session, plan or resource: the app opens your phone's browser for the payment.
The video room for a session opens from **Join**, in the browser or the meeting app its link belongs to.
